chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Abdullah and Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad, from Abu Khadeeja, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) cursed the men who resemble the women, and the women who resemble the men. He said: And they are the effeminate men and the women who marry each other.

key_terms.الْمُتَشَبِّهَاتِ: Those who imitate or resemble (specifically women imitating men)
key_terms.الْمُتَشَبِّهِينَ: Those who imitate or resemble (specifically men imitating women)
key_terms.الْمُخَنَّثُونَ: Effeminate men; men who adopt feminine mannerisms or appearance
key_terms.يَنْكِحْنَ: They marry; in this context, referring to women entering into marital-like unions with each other

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on men imitating women and women imitating men in Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the Prophet’s curse on those who blur gender distinctions, specifically identifying 'al-mukhannathun' (effeminate men) and 'allati yankihna ba'dahunna' (women who marry each other, a term often linked to female homosexuality or distinct female unions in Shia jurisprudence). It serves as a foundational text for understanding the prohibition of gender mimicry and same-sex relations, emphasizing the preservation of natural gender roles as a divine ordinance.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ali Bin Abdullah, and Abdullah Bin Al Rahman Bin Muhammad, from Abu Khadeeja, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> has cursed the men resembling themselves with the women, and the women resembling themselves with the men’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And they are the bisexuals and the sodomists/lesbians who are copulating with each other’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn Ali from Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah and ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad from abu Khadijah who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has condemned transvestites (those of men who pretend to be like women and women who pretend to be like men).’ He (the Imam) said, ‘They are hermaphrodites who engage in sexual intercourse with each other.’”
